summary: Rising Dragon Acquisition Corp., a blank-check company, filed an 8-K disclosing the issuance of two $50,000 unsecured promissory notes on May 15, 2026, to its sponsor Aurora Beacon LLC and SZG Limited (designee of HZJL Cayman Limited). The notes bear no interest, mature upon closing of the company's initial business combination, and the proceeds were deposited into the trust account to extend the business combination completion window to June 15, 2026. The notes may be converted into units at $10.00 per unit. This is a routine SPAC extension financing, not a definitive deal or termination. The filing highlights the company's ongoing search for a business combination within the extended deadline.
